In a setting described as unparalleled in Northern Ireland, on a course run on the Mall in the city centre park, the Russian Vyacheslav Shabunin had the beating of two Americans with Bristol & West's Rob Whalley first home for Britain in 6th, 14:14.

Mark Warmby of the Beagles took nearly half a minute out of Leeds but he in turn was being chased down by Bristol's Rob Whalley. Still in 7th, it was going to be an almighty battle for the Bels to reach the medals.
